author: Arjun Das
comment: Slightly off the main road but that is exactly why it is peaceful. Host arranged a local guide for us.

author: Sneha Iyer
comment: Clean, comfortable and very safe for solo travellers. Would come back in a heartbeat.

author: Rahul Nair
comment: Beautiful property, warm hosts, and the bonfire evening was the highlight of our trip.

author: Priya Menon
comment: Quiet, safe and exactly as described. The directions were spot on and the host checked in on us daily.

author: Vikram Shetty
comment: Genuinely felt like staying with family. Home-cooked breakfast and great tips on the hidden trails.

author: Ananya Rao
comment: Spotless rooms and the host waited up for our late arrival. Waking up to that view was unreal.
